bugs.bug: run unsets output, stderr, lines and stderr_lines at its start, so when `run` is invoked inside a helper that reads those variables, or without --separate-stderr, variables set by the caller (such as those used by bats-assert) are wiped before the command runs
bugs.example: test_functions.bash: `unset output stderr lines stderr_lines` runs unconditionally at the top of run(), destroying state the surrounding test or bats-assert helper still needs when the command itself reads or fails to set them
